fusions.name: Seen Through
fusions.desc: Sends an arm up to 7 tiles to the target's weak place, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaving the target [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: All-Round Watch
fusions.desc: Flicks an arm at each enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Skin That Sees
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Clocked
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
